Title: [LSJ]Toreador Grand Ball and Mask of 1000 faces

Messages.Author: Stelios
Messages.Body:
As now you could play with up to 6 tories with inf. obfuscate, I wonder what
happens with this situation:

Vamp A is selected with a TGB.
Vamp A attempts a Political Action.
No one attemps to block, as he is dancing all over the Elysium
Vamp B plays MOTF, finishing the action.

Can Prey/predator attemp to block the action?

I'm confused since MOTF allows perfomance of tricky situations such as:

Vamp A with 4 Aching Beautys attempts to bleed
Player b declines to bleed
Vamp B plays MOTF continuing the action where vamp A left it
Player b is not able to block, but can decide to deflect/reduce

Can you enlighten me at these points?

Thanks in advance

Stelios

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Stelios wrote:
>
> As now you could play with up to 6 tories with inf. obfuscate, I wonder what
> happens with this situation:
>
> Vamp A is selected with a TGB.
> Vamp A attempts a Political Action.
> No one attemps to block, as he is dancing all over the Elysium

Read: "A's controller asks for blockers and everyone declines to block"

> Vamp B plays MOTF, finishing the action.
>
> Can Prey/predator attemp to block the action?

No. The decision not to block is final.

> I'm confused since MOTF allows perfomance of tricky situations such as:
>
> Vamp A with 4 Aching Beautys attempts to bleed

> Player b declines to [block]

> Vamp B plays MOTF continuing the action where vamp A left it
> Player b is not able to block, but can decide to deflect/reduce

Correct.

Messages.Body:

>> Vamp A attempts a Political Action.
>> No one attemps to block, as he is dancing all over the Elysium

> Read: "A's controller asks for blockers and everyone declines to block"

The Grand Ball says that the non-bleed actions cannot be blocked.
Can you still *attempt* to block, just in case of Mask or other
strangeness? Or is this "declines to block" statement something forced?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
> The Grand Ball says that the non-bleed actions cannot be blocked.
> Can you still *attempt* to block, just in case of Mask or other
> strangeness?

No. A minion who cannot block an action cannot attempt to block the action.

> Or is this "declines to block" statement something forced?

It would be forced.
